This document outlines the auxiliary equipments inspection steps for Gas Turbine I1, which must 
be performed every 150 hours (what steps at 150 hours), 1000, and 2000 operating Hours

items:
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Check 
 differential pressure of filter for lube and control oil, clean filter if 
 requiered

Check 
 differential pressure of filter before shaft lift oil pump, clean filter if 
 required

Check oil 
 level in oil tank throngh sight, add oil if required

Check 
 differential pressure for fuel oil filter and clean if required

Clean the 
 filter in fuel gas line, if rquired

Lubricate 
 movable parbs for all points in miscellaneous control device (after 1000 
 operabing hours or 6 months)

Check the 
 stones and holders for the flame tube.

Check visually 
 the mining chamber and inner casing and flame.

Check 
 auxiliary air gates for fuel oil and fuel gas burners.

Check visually 
 the fuel oil mozzle and return line pipes and anial and diagonal swirler.
